meta.name: Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein
meta.description:
Relentlessly pursued by a powerful politician’s daughter who will do anything to make him hers, a man slips down a dark, risky path to reclaim his life.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 6/6

videos.title: Teri Baari Hai
videos.overview: College graduate Vikrant’s plans for his future are upended when an infamous politician offers him a job at the behest of his infatuated daughter, Purva.

videos.title: Band Toh Bajega
videos.overview: Reeling from what he witnessed in Akheraj’s office, Vikrant tells Purva his truth, but ensuing events make it clear he can’t get away so easily.

videos.title: Bandook Aur Hawaii Chappal
videos.overview: An increasingly desperate Vikrant makes several attempts to call off the engagement. An honest conversation with Akheraj has a disastrous outcome.

videos.title: 4 Goliyaan
videos.overview: A shocking discovery leaves Vikrant heartbroken. Now just days before the wedding, fear for his family’s life compels him to make a decision.

videos.title: Do You Love Me?
videos.overview: On the wedding night, Vikrant learns of an unexpected return. As his hunger for revenge deepens, a daring side of him begins to emerge.

videos.title: Jack and Jill
videos.overview: As Purva's suspicions grow, Akheraj’s men are sent to track down Vikrant’s secret. Vikrant considers putting a dangerous plot into action.

videos.title: Seedha Sa Plan
videos.overview: As Purva lets down her guard, Vikrant suggests a honeymoon — but has ulterior motives. However, he's not the only one making life-changing arrangements.

videos.title: The Crying Game
videos.overview: When a crucial plot falters, Vikrant intensifies his ruse with Purva ahead of her show. But even careful planning can't prepare him for what’s coming.

videos.title: Lag Gaye Kismat Ke Ghode
videos.overview: Amidst the search for Purva, Vikrant finds himself falling into deeper trouble. A figure from Purva’s past looms large and a ransom war triggers chaos.

videos.title: Aasmaan Se Gira Khajur Pe Atka
videos.overview: With Dharmesh as a threat, Vikrant is forced to take a violent step. Guru takes matters into his own hands when he learns of Purva’s disappearance.

videos.title: Aage Kuan Peeche Khaai
videos.overview: As doubts pervade his mind, Guru begins to question Vikrant and his family. Purva finds a way to send out a secret message.

videos.title: Saajan Niklu Bekaar
videos.overview: Guru successfully decodes Purva’s message. Akheraj reveals a connection to Sherpa. The ransom exchange triggers a tense shootout.

videos.title: Nehle Pe Dehla
videos.overview: A despondent Vikrant receives unexpected news. Purva’s rage takes aim at Shikha. Vikrant’s past catches up to him when an inspector arrives.

videos.title: Maar Hi Daaloge
videos.overview: At the funeral, plots for vengeance begin to unfurl. Vikrant implores his family and Shikha to flee. Sherpa’s true motives emerge.
